title: Pietak & Levin (2017) & Pietak & Levin (2016) Bioelectric Gene & Reaction Networks: Electrodiffusive Nernst-Planck Serotonin (5-HT) Transport Through Voltage-Gated Gap Junctions & Cryptic Two-Headed Planarian Memory

primary_papers.citation: Pietak A, Levin M (2017) Bioelectric gene and reaction networks: computational modelling of genetic, biochemical and bioelectrical dynamics in pattern regulation. J. R. Soc. Interface 14(134):20170425
Pietak A, Levin M (2016) Exploring Instructive Physiological Signaling with the Bioelectric Tissue Simulation Engine. Front. Bioeng. Biotechnol. 4:55

Durant F, Morokuma J, Fields C, Williams K, Adams DS, Levin M (2017) Long-Term, Stochastic Editing of Regenerative Anatomy via Targeting Endogenous Bioelectric Gradients. Biophys. J. 112(10):2231-2243

governing_equations.nernst_planck_gj_flux: J_s(x,t) = -D_s * G_gj(DeltaV) * (dc/dx + (z * F / (R * T)) * c * dV/dx)
governing_equations.boltzmann_equilibrium_ratio: c_post / c_ant = exp(-(z * F / (R * T)) * (V_post - V_ant)) = exp(-z * (V_post - V_ant) / V_T)
governing_equations.camp_pka_feedback_ode: tau_M * dM/dt = c^2 / (K_c^2 + c^2) + alpha_loop * B^2 / (K_B^2 + B^2) - M
governing_equations.erk_anterior_head_pde: tau_E * dE/dt = 1 / (1 + (B / K_BE)^2) - E + D_E * d^2E/dx^2
governing_equations.bistable_membrane_voltage_pde: C_m * dV/dt = -g_bistable * (V - V_hyper) * (V - V_thresh) * (V - V_depol) + I_wound(x) - I_K_feedback * B(x,t) + d/dx [ G_gj(dV/dx) * dV/dx ]

experimental_regimes.description: Wild-type planarian trunk fragment with anterior depolarization (-20 mV), posterior hyperpolarization (-60 mV), and open gap junctions (eta_oct=0): cationic 5-HT (z=+1) electrophoreses to the posterior wound (c_post/c_ant = 4.70), activating cAMP/PKA -> beta-catenin B(L) and suppressing posterior ERK E(L) -> 1 Head + 1 Tail (1H1T)

8-Octanol gap-junction blockade (eta_oct=0.92): blocks Nernst-Planck 5-HT electrophoresis into the posterior wound, collapsing posterior cAMP/PKA and beta-catenin and inducing bilateral ERK activation and depolarization -> 2 Heads + 0 Tails (2H0T)

Cryptic/permanent bioelectric memory after transient 8-octanol exposure (t in [0, t_wash]) followed by complete washout (eta_oct -> 0 for t > t_wash) and secondary cut: symmetric depolarized V_mem (-20 mV at both poles, DeltaV_AP = 0) and mutual B/E bistability lock in 2H0T double-head regeneration indefinitely after drug removal

H,K-ATPase inhibition / hyperpolarization (SCH-28080, V_ant = V_post = -60 mV) with uniform 5-HT / elevated cAMP-PKA agonist (forskolin/IBMX): bilateral beta-catenin stabilization suppresses ERK at both wounds -> 0 Heads + 2 Tails (0H2T headless)

Zero-valence Nernst-Planck ablation control (z = 0): neutral morphogen experiences zero electrophoretic drift despite normal 40 mV AP bioelectric gradient, yielding flat concentration c_post/c_ant = 1.00 and abolishing posterior tail polarity (2H0T)

Targeted posterior K+ channel hyperpolarization rescue applied to a cryptic 2H0T worm: re-establishing V_post = -60 mV restores posterior 5-HT Nernst-Planck electrophoresis (c_post/c_ant = 4.70) and resets regeneration from 2H0T back to wild-type 1H1T
